speaker: Doctor
text:
I must inform you that the symptoms of grunting, retractions, and cyanosis in a premature newborn born two hours ago are classic signs of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to surfactant deficiency, not Tuberculosis. Please note that Tuberculosis is a chronic infection that does not present acutely within hours of birth.
